name: APEX IRON: Corponation Augmented Combat League
description: APEX IRON is the fully corporate-owned augmented one-on-one combat league established by a joint venture between Axiom Workforce Solutions and Ferrous Latitude Pictures in 2200, featuring athletes contracted as corporate property and augmented at company expense in exchange for exclusive performance rights. Competitors wear full sponsor livery integrated into their chrome — advertising that is literally part of their bodies for the contract duration. Matches are broadcast across all Axiom and Ferrous Latitude channels with real-time betting markets and neural highlight packages sold as premium content.
story_hooks: An APEX IRON competitor discovers that the augmentation installed in her body without her full understanding contains a proprietary kill-switch that the corporation can activate to end her career — or worse — if she breaks contract.
A Tier 1 fan who has idolized a specific APEX IRON fighter for years gets the chance to meet their hero and discovers the person behind the chrome is desperate, controlled, and looking for a way out.
A corporate lawyer assigned to defend Axiom in the Okonkwo-Brandt arbitration begins to believe her client is wrong and must decide what to do with that conviction.
